verdict.rationale: Hatchet documents concurrency limits per key using CEL expressions, such as giving premium-tier users 10 concurrent workflows and others one. It also supports shared concurrency rules across workflows, like capping workflow_a and workflow_b at 10 runs per user, and queue-depth strategies per concurrency key. Rate limiting is only evidenced by a 'Rate Limits' doc page title with no described per-key or per-tenant behavior, and per-tenant isolation is only implied through per-user keys. missing for 10: documented rate-limit semantics (per workflow/key/tenant), explicit per-tenant fairness/limits, independent or hands-on corroboration of noisy-neighbor protection.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I cap concurrency and set rate limits per workflow, per key, or per tenant so one hot customer can't starve the rest

citations.quote: set concurrency limits on a per-key basis using a CEL expression. For example, let premium-tier users run 10 workflows simultaneously while other users run one
create concurrency rules that many tasks and workflows consume simultaneously, e.g. limiting `workflow_a` and `workflow_b` to 10 concurrent runs per user total
configure the queue depth for each concurrency key
